name: org.polarka/polarka-agent
title: Polarka Agent: a NORTH wallet for agents
description: Pays x402 in NORTH. Owner limits bind agents with shell access only through a signing service.

packageArguments.name: --dir
packageArguments.description: The wallet's folder; made on first start, with a wallet on main that pays nothing until its owner writes limits.json

environmentVariables.name: POLARKA_SIGNER
environmentVariables.description: The socket of a signing service (polarka-agent signer-setup): the agent then only asks it to pay, within the owner's limits, and cannot read the wallet's words
